LanguageData.RR_Gate_AssignOperatorDesc: Choose an employed staff member for the gate console.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_CalibrateDesc: Start a staffed calibration job at the powered console.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_StaffConsoleDesc: Order the assigned operator to reserve and staff the console.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_OperatorAway: Assigned operator away from the console: {0}
LanguageData.RR_Gate_JobUnavailable: The assigned staff member cannot start this gate job.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_ActiveCannotReassign: The operator cannot be changed while an expedition is active.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_StaffOnly: Only an employed company staff member can be assigned to the gate.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_InvalidExpedition: The expedition ID is missing or invalid.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_NotAssembled: The gate needs its physical materials and staffed assembly bill completed.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_NotCalibrated: The gate needs staffed calibration before opening.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_AlreadyOpen: The gate already has an active expedition.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_RecoveryRequired: The previous opening has failed. Use the recovery operation after the return window ends.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_RecoveryWindowStillActive: The bounded emergency-return window must expire before a recovery opening can begin.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_InvalidOperation: The operation receipt ID is missing or invalid.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_InvalidTimeCost: The opening time cost must be a positive number of ticks.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_OperationIdConflict: This operation receipt ID was already used for a different request.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_NoNormalWindow: The gate cannot apply a new time cost during its emergency-return window.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_OperatorNotStaffing: The assigned operator is not staffing the console.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_OperatorUnavailable: The assigned operator must be alive, capable, employed, and present on the facility map.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_PowerUnstable: The gate needs stable connected power and a charged return reserve.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_OpeningPowerUnstable: The connected power network cannot support the gate's configured opening load while retaining its required headroom.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_ExpeditionMismatch: The emergency-return request does not match the active expedition.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_NoEmergencyWindow: The gate has no active emergency-return window.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_WarningTenMinutes: The gate opening has about 10 in-game minutes remaining.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_WarningFiveMinutes: The gate opening has about 5 in-game minutes remaining.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_WarningTwoMinutes: The gate opening has about 2 in-game minutes remaining.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_NotOpen: The gate has no active expedition to interrupt.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_CalibrationUnavailable: The gate is not ready for calibration.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_MachineUnavailable: The gate machine is no longer available.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_InvalidAssemblyBill: The assembly bill did not target this installation's assigned assembly station.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateAssemblyCompleted: The machine assembly is complete. Assign a qualified operator and calibrate the gate.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateCalibrationCompleted: The machine calibration is complete. Staff the console and review the power reserve before dispatch.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateOpeningStarted: The gate opening has started. The expedition window is running.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateOpeningClosed: The gate opening is closed. Crew and cargo remain accounted for in the expedition record.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateEmergencyReturnPaid: Emergency return has committed {0} watt-days from the machine's reserve.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateRecoveryOpeningStarted: The recovery opening has started, spending {0} watt-days from the machine's reserve.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_TimeCostWindowExhausted: The recorded route distortion consumed the remaining normal opening. Use the emergency return while it remains available.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_KillSwitchDesc: Choose a power switch on this gate's own circuit as its emergency cutoff. Throwing that switch ends an opening at once and names itself as the cause. Only a switch that actually carries this gate's power can be chosen.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_KillSwitchArmed: Emergency cutoff: {0}, closed and carrying power.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_KillSwitchThrown: Emergency cutoff: {0} is OPEN. The gate has no supply.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_NoKillSwitchCandidates: No power switch on this gate's circuit. Wire one into the line that feeds the gate and turn it on.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_UnsupportedSwitch: That is not a power switch.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_SwitchMustBeOnToBind: The switch must be closed when it is chosen, so its circuit can be checked against the gate's.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_SwitchNotOnGateCircuit: That switch does not carry this gate's power. Wire it into the line that feeds the gate.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_SwitchAlreadyBound: Another gate already uses that switch as its cutoff.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateKillSwitchBound: An emergency cutoff was set on a gate.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_ServiceFine: Assembly condition: {0} days remaining, wearing at {1}x.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_ServiceWanted: Assembly condition: {0} days remaining, wearing at {1}x. Reconditioning wanted.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_ServiceLapsed: Assembly condition exhausted. The gate will not open until it is reconditioned.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_ServiceLapsed: The gate assembly is out of condition and must be reconditioned before it will open.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_ServiceNotWanted: The gate assembly does not need reconditioning yet.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpStarted: Bringing up a connection to {0}. The operator must stay on the console until it is open.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpLapsed: The connection lost its charge before it opened. The address is still remembered and can be dialled again.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpAborted: Spin-up stopped. The address is still remembered.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpWaiting: The connection is fully charged and waiting: {0}
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpBusy: This gate is already bringing up a different connection.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_SpinUpHeldReadout: Charged and waiting to open to {0}.
LanguageData.RR_Gate_AbortSpinUpDesc: Stop bringing up this connection. The work done so far is lost, but the address stays in this gate's history and can be dialled again.
